headline: Caregiver
summary: Former hotel housekeeping attendant now working as a caregiver for older adults in Isabela. Four years in housekeeping taught me to keep rooms spotless and to treat every guest with warmth; I trained in caregiving and have looked after elderly clients for the past year. I am trained in Basic Life Support.

certifications.name: Basic Life Support and First Aid

skills: Basic Life Support and first aid
Promoting healthy routines: meals, walking, rest
Warm, respectful guest and client relations

experience.title: Caregiver
bullets: Care for an elderly couple at home: bathing, dressing, meals, walks and companionship.
Keep their home and laundry clean and help them keep a daily routine.

experience.title: Housekeeping Attendant
bullets: Cleaned and prepared 14 to 16 rooms a shift to the hotel's inspection standard.
Handled linen and laundry for guest rooms and the function hall.
Answered guest requests politely and passed complaints to the supervisor.

education.credential: Senior High School, TVL Track – Home Economics strand
